system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Auspex, Intermediate Dementation. This uniquely Malkavian Discipline forces a twisted reflection of the user's own Auspex onto a target, always manifesting as distracting, painful or socially dangerous input, never anything beneficial. The user chooses a target, spends a Willpower Trait, and makes a Social Test retested with Empathy; the level of Auspex "granted" cannot exceed the user's own. Effects last a number of hours equal to the user's permanent Willpower Traits minus the target's current Willpower Traits (minimum one hour), and the user retains full normal use of his own Auspex throughout. All targets suffer a two-Trait penalty to Social and Mental tests for the duration and must roleplay their disorientation; particularly susceptible targets may need to spend a Willpower Trait or suffer an active Derangement. A target who already possesses the granted Auspex level may attempt a Mental Test with Awareness against the user's Mental Traits to realize something is wrong.

Costs 8 Experience Traits to learn.
system.duration: User's permanent Willpower minus target's current Willpower (min. 1 hour)
